samples.research_question: What is the economic impact of autonomous AI agents on corporate research productivity?

expected_evidence.excerpt: Autonomous AI agent workflows reduced research report generation cycles by 64% across enterprise deployments.
Organizations observed average operational computing cost reductions of 28% after implementing hybrid model routing.

expected_claims: Autonomous AI agent workflows significantly reduce report generation cycles.
Model routing optimization lowers enterprise computing costs.

expected_contradictions.description: Report A cites 64% cycle reduction while Report B cites 35% on legacy models.

samples.research_question: How do deterministic verification checks impact hallucination rates in generative AI systems?

expected_evidence.excerpt: Deterministic citation grounding eliminated unsupported claim generation, dropping hallucination frequency below 2%.

expected_claims: Deterministic grounding restricts hallucination frequency to under 2%.
